text:
maya: Hey team — need a compact one-page decision-tree diagram + three benchmark graphic variants for the upcoming launch. Outputs should cover: social hero, webinar slide, and a sales one-pager. Main idea: show tradeoffs between latency / cost / quality in an approachable way (not a dense chart).

jordan: Got it — can you confirm target sizes and file formats? Also any strict brand constraints beyond the usual palette?

liam: Priority order: 1) Decision-tree (single page, used as tweet thread visual + slide), 2) Social hero (1200x628), 3) 16:9 webinar slide + simplified sales one-pager. Use concise messaging: head copy = "Serving wins: lower cost, faster responses, same quality". CTA for webinar = "Register — May 14". Audience = product/engineering + buyer-facing SDRs.

maya: Accessibility is a must — include alt text for every asset and ensure contrast meets WCAG AA. Also need localized versions for APAC (zh-CN and ja-JP) for the hero and the slide. Brand guardrail: avoid heavy red gradients, use primary blue + charcoal. Keep icons geometric, not illustrative.

sofia: Legal note — anywhere we show model outputs or data examples, add the short disclosure: "Examples are synthetic and anonymized; do not contain customer data." Put this as fine print on slide/one-pager exports. Also flag any claims about SLA or cost with "actual results may vary" tag.

jordan: Thanks — that helps. ETA for first comps: 3 business days if copy and translations are stable. Can you drop final copy and the example benchmark numbers into the figma file? I prefer to design directly in Figma so exports are consistent.

maya: Pasting link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/launch-bench?node-id=0%3A1 — I uploaded the brand token file and the draft copy there. Quick spec block for exports:

```
- social_hero_1200x628.png (RGB, 72dpi)
- webinar_slide_16x9.pdf (vector, include alt meta in notes)
- onepager_sales_A4.pdf (print-ready, include legal footnote)
- decision_tree_800x1200.png (also provide SVG)
```

Please name exports with suffixes: _v1, _v2, etc.

jordan: Perfect — I'll create a component library and lay out the 3 comps. Will add alt text strings in Figma comments. If the APAC translations aren't ready in 24h, I'll proceed with en-US and mark text layers for localization.

asset-bot: Uploaded frame "decision-tree_v1" to Figma and created a comment with export tokens. https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/launch-bench?node-id=12%3A34

jen: Ops note — tagging this to the launch board. Priority set to P1 for the decision-tree. Requesting final assets by EOD Friday to hit the content calendar.

liam: I'll attach a short example data table to the figma page with 3 benchmark rows (latency ms / cost per 1k tokens / perceived quality score). Keep numbers illustrative, not tied to customers.

jordan: I'll start comps and ping if anything blocks. @maya @liam please ping here if you change copy or timing. :paintbrush:
